title: Let the form control take over the font of the area
goal: Use font: inherit to let the control inherit the font settings of the parent element.
summary: The text sizes in the registration area and search area are different, and the browser sets separate fonts for native controls. Let the controls in the two areas follow their parent.
tasks: Set the input and button in #card-form to inherit the font of the local area.
Keep the two regional fonts in the courseware and think about why writing only fixed font sizes cannot satisfy the two regions.

example.note: inherit causes the control to adopt the font calculation results of the parent element, including font size, font family and line height.

hint: The starting style here deliberately restores the default font of the control. Declare font: inherit with override rules.
